pages.title: Euclidean Marble
pages.text: White stone, flat on every face and square at every corner, as if each block had been laid out with compass and straightedge. Found in the Elements, the Platonic Realm's marble islands (Y 320 to 400). The Geometer's Table inlays it into Golden Ratio Glass, and lays out more from cobblestone and a Euclidean Shard.
